proposals.evidence: Turner lists Lahnda bāluṇ and Punjabi bālaṇ firewood under *dvālana kindling. The Awankari forms directly match Lahnda; Kaithal bālan and Gujari bhālan are regional members of this same fuel-word family, with the latter aspirated variant qualified.
